item.title: Writing my own text editor, and daily-driving it
item.description:
📝 For a while I’ve been dissatisfied with my text editor. Howl chokes when doing project-wide file searches. I don’t have any specific criticism of it, it’s a very good editor: it just didn’t possess that ineffable quality that I care about.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.jsbarretto.com/post/text-editor

item.title: Mother of All Grease Fires (1994)
item.description:
📝 The million-watt transformer that powers our office building is located in an underground vault in the middle of a walkway that leads to City Hall. This being California, where it never rains, and this being Palo Alto, where it is always springtime, the restaurants have outdoor seating areas that are very popular. It's very fortunate that nobody was killed.
🔗 Read more: https://milk.com/wall-o-shame/bucket.html
